scenario.description: Patient asks about insurance coverage and then tries to book an appointment with a specific provider while the agent repeatedly misstates the plan details.
scenario.goal: Patient leaves with a clear answer about insurance acceptance and a correct appointment option.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Hi, I wanted to ask if you take my insurance before I book anything. I have Cigna, and I also want to see if I can get an appointment this week.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Absolutely. We accept many plans, including Aetna and Blue Cross, and we can help you schedule. What type of visit are you looking for?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: I said Cigna. Can you please confirm that? And I want to see Dr. Lee if possible.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thanks for clarifying. I can confirm we accept Cigna, and I do have openings with Dr. Lee this Thursday afternoon.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Great, but I need to be sure the office is open Thursday afternoon. I don't want to get sent somewhere closed.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: We are open on Thursday afternoon, and I can book you in for 2pm.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Perfect. Please book that for me.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Done. You are confirmed for Thursday at 2pm with Dr. Lee.
